calculation_handling.description: When the roof of a lawfully existing residential building in the RD zone is altered, no more than 50 percent of the horizontal roof area may have a slope flatter than 1 vertical to 4 horizontal.
calculation_handling.gaps: No DSL target exists for roof slope or the share of roof area at a given slope, and the rule depends on the as-built status of the building; the numbers are listed as not expressed (closest closed reason).

units.disclosure: If you alter the roof of an existing house in the RD zone, most of the new roof (more than half its area) must keep a slope of at least 1 in 4. We do not check roof slope.

10.20.40.11(1).explanation: In the RD zone, an altered roof on a lawfully existing residential building cannot be flatter than a 1-in-4 slope over more than half of its horizontal roof area, in addition to the general roof rule in 10.5.40.11(3).
